repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#Garden_Button).button != "pushed")
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Garden_Button).button == "pushed")
(#Garden_Valve).valve.open()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: Current JoI uses simple if statement checking condition only at iteration start (period=1000ms). IR requires rising-edge wait on Button.Button=='pushed' with blocking semantics. At 100ms, button was already pushed (0ms->100ms held), but JoI's if only evaluated at 0ms and 1000ms, missing the rising edge detection. JoI lacks state tracking to detect edge transitions.
diagnosis.change_summary: Implemented rising-edge state machine: fired flag tracks prior edge, blocks until condition becomes true, executes action, then resets to prevent repeated firing while held. Preserves period=1000 and action call semantics matching IR.
